history.title: Work through the discoveries
history.intro: From Earth's size to unseen mass, follow major discoveries using observations and the laws of physics.
history.method: Follow each discovery in nine steps, from observations to calculations and reasoning. Work through one question at a time. Press and hold a dotted term for its meaning.
history.noReview: Nothing to review yet. Start with a story that interests you.

history.numberHelp: Enter a number only. Scientific notation such as 1.2e5 is supported.
history.hintNote: Hints open one step at a time. The number used is saved with your answer.

history.notesLocal: Notes and answers are saved on this device and can be included in a backup.
